description.en: Mlinar France's workshop: the workbench, the saw and the boards, the ladder and the wheelbarrow, and the little wooden horse he is carving for Tine.
description.de: Die Werkstatt von Mlinar France: die Werkbank, die Säge und die Bretter, die Leiter und die Schubkarre, und das kleine Holzpferd, das er für Tine schnitzt.
description.it: Il laboratorio di Mlinar France: il banco da lavoro, la sega e le assi, la scala e la carriola, e il cavallino di legno che sta intagliando per Tine.

review: sl, en, de, it: machine-written, not reviewed by a native speaker

words.example_en: The tools are on the workbench.
words.example_de: Das Werkzeug liegt auf der Werkbank.
words.example_it: Gli attrezzi sono sul banco da lavoro.
words.note: Literally 'work table'. Both words change: na delovni mizi.
words.note_de: Wörtlich „Arbeitstisch“. Beide Wörter ändern sich: na delovni mizi.
words.note_it: Letteralmente 'tavolo da lavoro'. Cambiano entrambe le parole: na delovni mizi.

words.example_en: The saw hangs on the wall.
words.example_de: Die Säge hängt an der Wand.
words.example_it: La sega è appesa al muro.
words.note: Žagam = I saw. Žagarija = a sawmill.
words.note_de: Žagam = ich säge. Žagarija = ein Sägewerk.

words.note: Dual: dve deski. Plural: tri deske.
words.note_de: Dual: dve deski. Plural: tri deske.
words.note_it: Duale: dve deski. Plurale: tri deske.

words.example_en: The little horse is made of wood.
words.note: Iz lesa (genitive): made of wood. Firewood is drva.
words.note_de: Iz lesa (Genitiv): aus Holz. Brennholz heißt drva.
words.note_it: Iz lesa (genitivo): di legno. La legna da ardere è drva.

words.example_en: The ladder stands against the wall.
words.example_de: Die Leiter steht an der Wand.
words.example_it: La scala è appoggiata al muro.
words.note: Feminine although it ends in a consonant: ta lestev, na lestvi.
words.note_de: Weiblich, obwohl es auf einen Konsonanten endet: ta lestev, na lestvi.
words.note_it: Femminile anche se finisce in consonante: ta lestev, na lestvi.

words.example_en: Tine is sweeping with the broom.
There is wood in the wheelbarrow.
words.note: Sam (by itself) + kolo (wheel): a cart with one wheel.
words.note_de: Sam (von selbst) + kolo (Rad): ein Karren mit einem Rad.
words.note_it: Sam (da solo) + kolo (ruota): un carretto con una ruota.

words.example_en: Grandpa is making a little horse for Tine.
words.example_de: Opa macht ein Pferdchen für Tine.
words.example_it: Il nonno fa un cavallino per Tine.
words.note: From konj (horse). Also 'hobby': Moj konjiček je branje.
words.note_de: Von konj (Pferd). Auch „Hobby“: Moj konjiček je branje.
words.note_it: Da konj (cavallo). Anche 'hobby': Moj konjiček je branje.

words.note: A nail is žebelj; a screw is vijak.
words.note_de: Ein Nagel ist žebelj, eine Schraube vijak.
words.note_it: Il chiodo è žebelj, la vite è vijak.

words.note: lesen (m), lesena (f), leseno (n): lesen konjiček, lesena miza.
words.note_de: lesen (m), lesena (f), leseno (n): lesen konjiček, lesena miza.
words.note_it: lesen (m), lesena (f), leseno (n): lesen konjiček, lesena miza.

words.note: Infinitive žagati: žagam, žagaš, žaga. What you saw is the object: desko (accusative).
words.note_de: Infinitiv žagati: žagam, žagaš, žaga. Was man sägt, ist das Objekt: desko (Akkusativ).
words.note_it: Infinito žagati: žagam, žagaš, žaga. Ciò che si sega è l'oggetto: desko (accusativo).

words.example_en: I am measuring the board. A metre and a half.
words.example_de: Ich messe das Brett. Anderthalb Meter.
words.example_it: Misuro l'asse. Un metro e mezzo.
words.note: Infinitive meriti: merim, meriš, meri. Meter in pol = a metre and a half.
words.note_de: Infinitiv meriti: merim, meriš, meri. Meter in pol = anderthalb Meter.
words.note_it: Infinito meriti: merim, meriš, meri. Meter in pol = un metro e mezzo.

words.example_en: I hammer a nail into the board.
words.example_de: Ich schlage einen Nagel ins Brett.
words.note: V desko (accusative): into the board, a direction. Perfective: once, done.
words.note_de: V desko (Akkusativ): ins Brett, eine Richtung. Perfektiv: einmal, fertig.
words.note_it: V desko (accusativo): nell'asse, una direzione. Perfettivo: una volta, finito.
